original: sākṣād iti bāhyamudrāyā na tu jñānamudrā(240r/483)yā eva | varṣāt paraṃ samayo 'laṅghanīyo mudrāyogaḥ | tatkṣatau pramādaḥ skhalanam | yogān mahāsukhāt | samayasyotthāpanaṃ prajñājñānābhiṣekeṇa | viśeṣataḥ śūnyatākaruṇābhinnabodhicittaṃ samayakṣatāv anusmartavyam | mṛdus tv amoghasiddhiyogavān sarvān abhiṣekān gṛhnīyāt | vidadha vidadhyāt |
analyzed: sākṣāt iti bāhya mudrāyāḥ na tu jñānamudrāyāḥ eva varṣāt param samayaḥ laṅghanīyaḥ mudrā yogaḥ tad kṣatau pramādaḥ skhalanam yogāt mahā sukhāt samayasya utthāpanam prajñā jñāna abhiṣekeṇa viśeṣataḥ śūnyatā karuṇā bhinna bodhi cittam samaya kṣatau anusmartavyam mṛduḥ tu amogha siddhi yogavān sarvān abhiṣekān gṛhnīyāt vidadha vidadhyāt

original: samvara ukto vakṣyate ca | niruttaras tu samvaro bodhicittaṃ sarvadharmasaṃkṣeparūpatvāt (240v/484) bodhicittasya sarvākuśalebhyo 'satkalpanābhyaś ca samvaraṇāt | rahasyadravyāṇi varṣānvitotsāhārthaṃ vakṣyamāṇāni | mantratantrair iti | utpattiyoginā pañcakulakalāpinītvādyarthaṃ dhyayābhir (!?) mantravyutpattibhir vakṣyamāṇābhiḥ |
analyzed: samvaraḥ uktaḥ vakṣyate ca niruttaraḥ tu samvaraḥ bodhi cittam sarva dharma saṃkṣepa rūpa tvāt bodhi cittasya sarva akuśalebhyaḥ sat kalpanābhyaḥ ca samvaraṇāt rahasya dravyāṇi varṣa anvita utsāha artham vakṣyamāṇāni mantra tantraiḥ iti utpatti yoginā pañca kula kalāpinī tva ādi artham dhyayā ābhiḥ mantra vyutpattibhiḥ vakṣyamāṇābhiḥ
